scoredWith.ask: Solve on the whiteboard, showing each step: A decentralized renewable energy cooperative is analyzing the financial viability of a new municipal microgrid. The initial infrastructure capital expenditure requires an upfront investment of \$45,000. Operating the microgrid incurs a variable maintenance cost of \$125 per household connected per month, while each household generates \$400 per month in utility revenue for the cooperative. Determine the exact number of households $h$ that must be connected so that the net profit reaches \$60,000 after accounting for both the initial capital expenditure and the cumulative monthly net operating income over a single year (12 months). First, construct the appropriate linear equation to model this financial trajectory.

scoredWith.ask: Solve on the whiteboard, showing each step: A civic architectural firm is designing a multi-tiered public pavilion. The blueprint specifies that the primary steel support beam must have a total length of \$134$ meters. Engineers plan to partition this beam into a fixed structural anchor of \$14$ meters and four identical modular segments, though manufacturing tolerances require incorporating a \$2$ meter expansion joint into each of the four modular segments after they are cast. Determine the exact length of each unadjusted modular segment before the expansion joint is integrated, and select the appropriate algebraic model that accurately represents this configuration.
